multiScaleR model selection

Source: R/aic_tab.R
aic_tab.Rd

Creates a model selection table ranked by AIC or AICc for a list of fitted models. Mixed lists containing both multiScaleR objects and plain model objects (e.g., glm) are supported, allowing comparison of scale-optimized models against fixed-scale alternatives.

Usage

aic_tab(mod_list,
        AICc = TRUE,
        mod_names = NULL,
        verbose = FALSE,
        ...)

Arguments

mod_list

List containing fitted multiScaleR objects (from multiScale_optim) and/or plain fitted model objects (e.g., glm, lm). All models must have been fit to the same set of observations; an error is raised if sample sizes differ.

AICc

Logical. If TRUE (default), the second-order corrected AIC (AICc) is used. Set to FALSE for standard AIC. AICc is recommended when the ratio of observations to parameters is small (n / K < 40 is a common rule of thumb).

mod_names

Optional character vector of model names. Length must equal length(mod_list). By default, names are constructed as [kernel]right-hand-side-formula for multiScaleR objects.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, the table is also printed to the console. Default: FALSE.

...

Additional arguments (not used).

Value

A data frame of class "aictab" (from the AICcmodavg package) sorted by ascending AIC(c), containing:

Modnames

Model name (from mod_names or auto-generated).

K

Number of fitted likelihood parameters, including ancillary parameters such as negative-binomial dispersion, plus optimized scale and shape parameters for multiScaleR models.

AICc or AIC

Information criterion value.

Delta_AICc or Delta_AIC

Difference from the top model.

ModelLik

Relative likelihood (exp(-0.5 * Delta)).

AICcWt or AICWt

Akaike weight.

LL

Log-likelihood.

Cum.Wt

Cumulative Akaike weight.

Details

The table is constructed using aictabCustom from the AICcmodavg package. For multiScaleR objects, the optimized (refitted) model stored in opt_mod is used for log-likelihood and parameter count. The sigma parameter (and shape for "expow") is added to K automatically. For plain model objects in a mixed list, sigma is not added to K. The fitted model's log-likelihood degrees of freedom are used when available, so negative-binomial dispersion contributes one parameter. For unmarkedFit models, native AIC and log-likelihood metadata determine the count, including detection coefficients, factor contrasts, mixture parameters, and estimated random-effect variances. Optimizer and TMB free-parameter metadata are checked for agreement when present. Latent random effects and the integration limit K are not counted. Missing or inconsistent parameter metadata and non-finite log-likelihoods raise an error instead of guessing from predictor names. AICc tables raise an error if any model has n <= K + 1; use AICc = FALSE for an AIC table in that case.

Author

Bill Peterman

Examples

## Bundled counts simulated with a habitat scale of 75 map units
data("pts")
data("count_data")
hab <- terra::rast(system.file("extdata", "hab.tif", package = "multiScaleR"))
prepared <- kernel_prep(pts, hab, max_D = 300, sigma = 75, verbose = FALSE)
dat <- data.frame(y = count_data$y, prepared$kernel_dat)
fixed_model <- glm(y ~ hab, family = poisson(), data = dat)
null_model <- glm(y ~ 1, family = poisson(), data = dat)
spatial_model <- multiScale_optim(fixed_model, prepared, par = 75 / 300,
                                  n_cores = 1, verbose = FALSE)
#> 
#> 
#> Optimization complete
models <- list(spatial = spatial_model, fixed = fixed_model, null = null_model)

## The spatial model pays for one extra estimated sigma parameter.
aic_tab(models, AICc = FALSE, mod_names = names(models))
#> 
#> Model selection based on AIC:
#> 
#>         K    AIC Delta_AIC AICWt Cum.Wt      LL
#> fixed   2 232.34      0.00  0.73   0.73 -114.17
#> spatial 3 234.33      1.99  0.27   1.00 -114.17
#> null    1 346.69    114.35  0.00   1.00 -172.34
#> 
aic_tab(models, AICc = TRUE, mod_names = names(models))
#> 
#> Model selection based on AICc:
#> 
#>         K   AICc Delta_AICc AICcWt Cum.Wt      LL
#> fixed   2 232.51       0.00   0.75   0.75 -114.17
#> spatial 3 234.67       2.16   0.25   1.00 -114.17
#> null    1 346.74     114.23   0.00   1.00 -172.34
#>
